newspaper.headline: Nusa Digital Developer Team Welcomes a New Member
newspaper.lead: The Nusa Digital developer team has a new member. First tasks: fixing bugs, writing Python functions, and reviewing teammates' code.

tip.title: Tip: Read Errors from the Bottom
tip.text: The most important part of a Python error is the last line: the error type and explanation. The line number shows where the problem is.

newspaper.classified: WANTED: A developer who isn't scared of red text. Contact Dimas, floor 4.
